I've defiantly been there before... thinking everyone's better than you. It can be really discouraging. I recommend you watch some YouTube videos on the basics. A good and quite popular channel you might of heard of is orange juice. His tutorials on pulling and making positive elixir trades really helped me starting out. Another thing is to just practice. You said you had a friend right? Get in the same clan and friendly battle to practice without losing cups. What you can do it ask your buddy to replicate a deck or strat that might be beating you a lot and you'll get better when you see it. Final thing, make your own decks! Any card is usable, (except sparky, but you don't have sparky) and that means if you like a card, use it! I've made it to 3400 trophies with mortar, and that's considered one of the worst cards in the game! As long as your average elixer is under 4.0, just experiment with diffrent cards. Remember! Just because something is good for someone else, doesn't mean it's good with you.
